en.headline: Huanggang Port to hold four days of drills with 36,000 civil-servant trips
en.dek: The government will mobilise about 36,000 civil-servant attendances across four dates this month to test clearance systems and capacity at the redeveloped checkpoint, with the largest exercise on 29 August.
body: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government plans to activate its whole-of-government mobilisation mechanism for four large-scale drills at the new Huanggang Port this month, involving roughly 36,000 civil-servant trips in total.

According to an internal circular reported by Ming Pao, the exercises will take place on 13 August (a weekday) and three subsequent Saturdays, with the 29 August session expected to draw 15,000 to 20,000 participants. Civil servants will act as simulated cross-boundary travellers to test immigration and customs systems, vehicle channels and overall handling capacity. Public transport may also be deployed to replicate real passenger and traffic conditions.

The Security Bureau said early opening of the port remains a shared goal of the Hong Kong and Shenzhen governments. Formal commissioning will be decided only after both sides confirm that operations are safe and smooth. Participants have been reminded to hold valid Home Return Permits, as they will simulate outbound travel. Travel expenses incurred during the drills may be claimed under civil-service regulations.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸將演練四日 動員公務員約3.6萬人次
zh.dek: 政府本月四個日子啟動全政府總動員，徵召約3.6萬人次公務員模擬過境，測試皇崗口岸通關系統及運載能力，其中8月29日規模最大。
body: 特區政府計劃本月啟動全政府總動員機制，於四個日子在新建皇崗口岸進行大型演練，合共動員約3.6萬人次公務員，模擬過境旅客測試通關系統及運載能力。
據明報引述內部通告，四日演練分別於本月13日（平日）及之後三個周六進行，其中8月29日規模最大，預計有1.5萬至2萬名公務員參與。當局亦擬調動公共交通工具，模擬真實旅客過關及交通情況。參加者須持有效回鄉證，扮演出境旅客角色，預料深圳方面亦會參與，以測試過關通道及「聯合一站式」車道等運作。
保安局表示，口岸早日開通是港深兩地政府共同目標，待雙方確認口岸具備安全、暢順運作條件後，粵港兩地政府會敲定並公布正式開通日期。演練期間涉及的交通費可根據《公務員事務規例》發還。
